ponder.astranautics.hold: Hold W: how to use this
ponder.astranautics.physics_switch.title: Making it physical
Place it and right-click to switch it ON. The connected blocks within 10 blocks become one rigid body.
A short left-click punches it around, holding left-click mines a block.
ponder.astranautics.physics_switch.title: Releasing it
Right-click the switch on the hull, or place a switch next to it and switch that ON.
A hull that has settled falls asleep and stops costing anything.
ponder.astranautics.balloon.body.0:
One balloon holds up 1.5 units of mass. Pack them on one side and the hull tilts away from its centre of mass.
Crafted from 4 white wool and leather.
ponder.astranautics.balloon.body.1:
Air pressure falls with height, so a hull settles where lift x pressure equals its weight.
A hollow hull floats on the air it seals in; fill that space and it sinks.
ponder.astranautics.propeller.body.0:
It pushes the way it faces. On a hull, right-click to switch it ON or OFF.
A running propeller uses the bright-bladed model.
ponder.astranautics.propeller.body.1:
Shaft it to a steam engine and thrust rises with RPM, up to three times its base.
Thrust dies off at the airflow speed, so more propellers mean more acceleration, not more top speed.
ponder.astranautics.steam_engine.body.0:
Right-click with fuel (coal, charcoal, coal block, blaze rod) to stoke it.
Sneak-right-click steps the throttle 0-1-2-3-4-0; an empty hand reports its state.
ponder.astranautics.steam_engine.body.1:
RPM takes 0.35 s to reach a new setting, plus 0.45 s per flywheel on the drivetrain.
Opening the throttle burns fuel faster.
ponder.astranautics.shaft.body.0:
Carries rotation along its own axis. Two parts only mesh when they share an axis and sit end to end.
When you build onto a hull, the axis follows the way you are looking.
ponder.astranautics.shaft.body.1:
Side-by-side shafts do not transmit.
Put a cogwheel where the drivetrain has to bend.
ponder.astranautics.cogwheel.body.0:
The only part that meshes with anything, whatever its axis.
One is all it takes to bend a drivetrain.
ponder.astranautics.cogwheel.body.1: Engine, shaft, cogwheel, shaft, propeller - that is how an airship pushes in a direction other than its engine's.
ponder.astranautics.flywheel.body.0:
It transmits like a shaft and adds inertia on top.
Each one makes the engine respond 0.45 s slower.
ponder.astranautics.flywheel.body.1:
It smooths out sudden starts and stops on a heavy ship, which makes landing and towing calmer.
It is heavy, so do not stack them without thinking.
